legal.title: Legal notice & privacy
legal.editorBody: This site is published by {owner}. Any question: {email}.
legal.hostingBody: The site is hosted by Vercel Inc., 340 S Lemon Ave #4133, Walnut, CA 91789, USA.
legal.dataBody: Wandeal requires no account and collects no personal data. Your favourites and search history stay in your browser's local storage and are never sent to us. Search criteria are sent to our server and then to OpenAI to generate suggestions; they are not kept beyond a one-hour technical cache. We use Vercel Analytics, a cookie-free audience measurement with no personal identifier.
legal.affiliateBody: The "See flights" and "Hotels" buttons link to Aviasales and Hotellook through the Travelpayouts affiliate programme. If you book after clicking, we earn a commission paid by the provider. The price you pay is exactly the same. This does not influence how destinations are ranked, which depends only on your criteria.
legal.pricesBody: Displayed amounts are estimates generated by AI and pricing APIs, for guidance only. They are neither an offer nor a contractual commitment. Only the price shown by the provider at booking time applies.
legal.liabilityBody: Wandeal is an inspiration engine, not a travel agency. We sell no flights, no accommodation and no packages, and we are not party to your relationship with the provider. Always check terms, entry requirements and insurance before booking.
legal.contactBody: A question, or something to report? Write to {email}.
